MQTT::keep_alive
Description
This command gets or sets the keep_alive field of MQTT CONNECT
message.
Syntax
MQTT
::
keep_alive
[
<
keepalive_seconds
>
]
MQTT::keep_alive
Get the keep_alive field of MQTT CONNECT message.
MQTT::keep_alive <keepalive_seconds>
Set the keep_alive field of MQTT CONNECT message to specified number.
The number must be smaller than 65536.
Examples
Related Information
Valid Events:
MQTT_CLIENT_INGRESS, MQTT_SERVER_INGRESS, MQTT_CLIENT_DATA,
MQTT_SERVER_DATA
